supported_fields.mechanics: Short-range Ki Blast shockwave/projectile that can cancel incoming Ki Blasts and launches the opponent into an unusually long slow-motion knockback, enabling follow-up attacks.

limits: No universal damage percentage or exact cancelable-projectile list is promoted as canonical.
The long-knockback behavior is documented; tactical recommendations from community discussion are not treated as canonical mechanics.
No new hidden mentor prerequisite is inferred.
